feasibility_reasoning:
The mechanism works, but it does not work for the stated reason.

Root cause of the cost:
- React 19.2 updateProperties compares props by identity (node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js:21122-21127) and then writes innerHTML unconditionally (:20407-20420).
- DesignTokensStyle.tsx:75 passes a fresh {{__html: html}} on every render, so any re-render rewrites the 26.6 KB :root sheet even when the text is identical.
- The trigger is useFontScale (DesignTokensStyle.tsx:48), because ["site_font_scale"] is not warmed (__root.tsx:631-639). Its data goes from undefined to {} (the column default is '{}'), the hash stays the same, and the DOM write still happens.
- Trace proof: in runs/m4-ok-1 the brand #text swap at 3174 ms has no data-css-hash attribute change.

Misattributions in the change:
- The "~2.92 s swaps" are header <style> rewrites in the --sticky-header-h / data-settled commit. They happen before the fetch completes (2948 ms) and also appear in m4-dead-1 at 2423 ms with a dead backend.
- The ContentAreaStyle swap does not happen in the fixture: the fetched defaults deep-equal the seed, so structural sharing keeps the same reference and nothing re-renders. In production it is unproven.

Gates:
- check:ssr-budgets passes today at 11/11 (I ran it). With H2 it becomes 10/11: -1 globalColors ensure, -1 merged seed (__root.tsx:676-685), +1 postLayout ensure.
- Wave-1 arms go to 3 (limit 6). Entry purity is unchanged.

Collateral the change does not list:
- The save hooks must patch the row instead of their old keys: designTokens.ts:154, useGlobalColors.ts:46, useFontScale.ts:46. Otherwise editor/admin views go stale after a save.
- The homeDeadline cancel loop (__root.tsx:642-652) must use the row key.
- rootRoute.test.tsx:134-140, :396-397 and :419-421 must be rewritten.
- The post_layout warm reverses the deliberate decision at __root.tsx:573-577 (PR #314) and adds one SSR subrequest on every chrome route whenever the edge TTL misses.

SSR parity, i18n, SEO, CLS and a11y are fine.
blocking_issues: Admin/editor save hooks write per-key shapes (designTokens.ts:154, useGlobalColors.ts:46, useFontScale.ts:46): they must patch the single row key, or editors see stale tokens, colors or font scale after a save.

The homeDeadline cancel loop at __root.tsx:642-652 and the seeds at __root.tsx:676-685 must switch to the row key; rootRoute.test.tsx (mocks at 134-140, assertions at 396-397 and 419-421) must be rewritten.

The post_layout_settings network warm reverses the deliberate decision at __root.tsx:573-577 (PR #314): it adds an SSR subrequest on every chrome route on an edge-TTL miss, for no proven homepage gain.

The effect attribution is wrong. The removed cost is an identical-text innerHTML rewrite of style[data-brand-tokens], caused by a re-render plus React 19's identity comparison of dangerouslySetInnerHTML (DesignTokensStyle.tsx:75). It is not a font-scale data change, and the 2.92 s swaps are header styles.
effect_reasoning:
The task being removed is real. Every ok-backend trace shows a brand-sheet swap followed immediately by a ULT+Layout task:
- m4-ok-1: 292 ms (ULT 115 + Layout 143)
- m4b-ok-2: 264 ms
- d4-ok-1: 370 ms
- m4-dead-1: 392 ms at 9.9 s, with no other mutation in that window. The header commit alone (2788 ms) produced no long task.

How Lantern turns this into TBT:
- It is a layout task, so Lantern applies layoutTaskMultiplier = cpu × 0.5 (Simulator.js:101,239): ×2 on mobile and ×0.5 on desktop, not ×4/×1.
- Observed sandbox duration is about CDP-4x/4 = 66-98 ms.
- Mobile on the sandbox host: 132-196 ms simulated, so TBT -82..-146 ms (analyst table: -100 ms = +2.5 pts, -200 ms = +5.5 pts → +2..+4 pts).
- Mobile on a PSI-like host (1.5-3× slower than the sandbox): -150..-300 ms, about +4..+7 pts. The task stays before TTI_sim in production (fetch observed at 3.9 s, TTI 10.6 s).
- Desktop: 33-49 ms simulated on the sandbox, so 0. On the PSI host (about 3× the sandbox): 100-145 ms, so TBT -50..-95 ms, about +1..+3 pts.

Other claimed effects:
- The 2 PostgREST requests and 2 preflights are post-FCP and off the critical path, so they are worth about 0.
- The ContentAreaStyle and post_layout parts are about 0 (no swap in the fixture; class-scoped rules).

Measurement caveat: the canonical LH harness has a dead client backend, so the rewrite fires late on the failure path. An A/B there may read anywhere from ~0 to the full delta.

Cheaper change with the same or larger effect (XS-S effort):
- Render each root <style> sink as a React.memo leaf that takes the primitive css string, keeping {__html: hardenStyleCss(css)} inline so check:dangerous-html (dangerousHtml.ts:1078) stays green.
- Apply it to DesignTokensStyle, ThemeDesign, ThemeOptions, ThemeFontSizes, ContentAreaStyle and the header blocks.
- This kills identical-content rewrites whatever triggers the re-render, and needs no change to the loader, cache writes, admin hooks or tests.
corrected_estimate:
H2 as specified:
- Mobile TBT: -80..-150 ms on the sandbox host, -150..-300 ms on a PSI-like host (+2..+7 pts). This assumes production font_scale is empty, which CLS 0 suggests.
- Desktop TBT: 0 on the sandbox, -50..-95 ms on the PSI host (+1..+3 pts).
- Corrected effect list: one identical-text rewrite of the 26.6 KB brand sheet removed, not "-2 style swaps". The ContentAreaStyle/post_layout part is about 0. The network savings are about 0 score.

Recommendation: ship the memo'd style-leaf fix first. It gives at least the same TBT for XS effort and also covers re-renders from H1 stale refetches and the header sheets. Keep only the font-scale select projection of H2, as an optional correctness follow-up for tenants with custom font sizes, and drop the post_layout warm.

better_alternative: Wrap each root <style> sink in a React.memo leaf that takes a primitive css string and renders dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: hardenStyleCss(css) }} inline, so check:dangerous-html stays green. Apply it to DesignTokensStyle, ThemeDesignStyle, ThemeOptionsStyle, ThemeFontSizesStyle, ContentAreaStyle and the header style blocks. React 19 then skips innerHTML writes when the text is unchanged, which removes the ~260-390 ms (CDP 4x) full recalc+layout whatever triggers the re-render. Optionally, also derive font scale from the already-dehydrated tokens row via select, for correctness only.
